propositions: Pass-1 submits all chunk and agent futures at once into a 6-wide pool, so a cold cache pays redundant cache writes for the identical plan-bearing system prefix.

Port the proven container-bin warm-then-fan-out gate to the main pool: when estimated shared-prefix tokens exceed CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and there are at least 2 Pass-1 calls, run the first chunk serially to write the cache prefix before fanning out the remainder.
Small plans and single-call reviews bypass the warm-up and behave unchanged.
A non-systemic warm-call failure degrades to direct fan-out and the review still completes, while a systemic LLMUnavailableError aborts.
The shared prefix should incur exactly one cache write and N-1 cache reads, verified via per-call usage records.
